I had a chance a few weeks ago to attend a Lecture & Bootcamp hosted by NVIDIA's Christopher Parisien & Griffin Lacey, where I learned a lot about LLM Security (input/output monitoring, anti-jailbreaking...) using NVIDIA's open source libraries NeMo Guardrails & garak. (+NIMs!) LLM security is becoming increasingly important with the widespread adoption of LLMs, especially if they're client facing! In my ongoing mission to optimize my personal performance in escape rooms through ethically questionable means, I needed to find out which LLMs would had my back when the stakes were high (and it was time to blatantly cheat). So... I made an LLM benchmark to test their physical reasoning capabilities, and also answer some questions along the way - What is a LLM benchmark? What makes a good LLM benchmark? What good ones exist already? Can Haiku-3.5 help me get a ping pong ball out of a narrow tub
Just put my first article on TDS, hopefully more to come! 🤠
